reuse.why: Extends the existing isSkippedDay helper that every holiday check in the tree already goes through.

duplication.why: The yearly-match rule is added once, inside the single shared predicate; no copies elsewhere.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines it.

scope.why: A three-line change to one predicate plus two focused tests.

maintainability.why: Small, documented change at the one definition all callers share.
